references.text: Joshua commanded the sun and moon to stand still during the battle against the Amorites, showing that celestial bodies participate in the Lord's wars.
The sun, moon, and stars are called to praise the Lord, demonstrating that heavenly bodies are under God's control and serve His will.
Isaiah prophesies that the stars will not shine on the day of the Lord, indicating cosmic signs connected with God's judgment.
Joel describes how the sun and moon are darkened and the stars lose their brightness on the day of the Lord.
Revelation describes stars falling from heaven, illustrating cosmic forces at work in spiritual warfare.
Jesus speaks of stars falling from heaven as a sign of the coming of the Son of Man, linking heavenly phenomena to God's intervention.
